description:
The composer keeps bash script output visible. The test seeded a conversation at /c/term-script, whose directory holds script.sh, which echoes "script-output". To choose a terminal menu item, click the button with aria-label exactly "Terminal menu", then the button with exactly that text inside ".overflow-menu-panel" (two real clicks). 
1. Navigate to /c/term-script. Send "!bash script.sh" (fill [data-testid="message-input"] with it and click [data-testid="send-button"]). There should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab-success".
2. Choose the terminal menu item "Insert all output into input". The message input's value should contain "script-output".
